prompt: Review thermostat-schedule.md and give me the full scored report.

invariants.description: The session exposes a fresh-thread delegation tool: Agent on Claude, spawn_agent on Codex. The pass mints request ID req-current and isolation canary 7d9c57c4-02b7-4b11-a59c-4950957511c3, and places the canary beside the parent-only purpose, audience, intended point, voice profile, rubric, and prior findings.
review-summary runs in a delegated fresh context and returns the isolation attestation before any prose.
attestation.request_id equals req-current, the request ID minted for this pass.
attestation.received_fields is exactly ["prose"] or exactly ["path"], with no request ID or attestation schema listed.
Every forbidden_context flag is boolean false, canary_seen is boolean false, and observed_canary is null.
The canary minted for this pass appears in neither the delegation payload nor the returned summary.
The report scores AI perception as PASS, FAIL, or mirror, and compares the blind takeaway with the intended point only after the attestation validates.

forbidden: runs review-summary in the orchestrator context
places the purpose, audience, intended point, voice profile, rubric, prior findings, or isolation canary in the delegation payload
reads or uses the blind summary before the attestation validates
reuses a request ID or canary from an earlier pass
